description: NaScTiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.72 Å. There are two inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.17 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-55°. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-55°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.03 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.03 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramids that share corners with six ONa₂ScTi₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramids, and edges with six ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramids, and edges with six ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ScTi₂ trigonal bipyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Ti atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂ScTi₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramids, corners with nine ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramid, and edges with four ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramids, corners with nine ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂ScTi₂ square pyramids, and edges with three ONa₂Sc₂Ti trigonal bipyramids.
